create_empty_memory: create an empty memory structure with version, user context, history, and facts fields
load_memory_storage: load cached memory data for a given agent with file modification time validation
reload_memory_storage: force reload memory data from file bypassing the cache for a given agent
save_memory_storage: save memory data to a file atomically using a temp file and update the cache
get_memory_storage: get the configured memory storage instance with lazy initialization and fallback to FileMemoryStorage
